message.content: On September 20th, 2026, Thane Chambers asked Li Hua about his favorite first-person shooter game. Specifically, Thane inquired, "What’s your favorite first-person shooter game? I'm curious! 🎮" Li Hua responded by saying he's really into "Call of Duty: Warzone" lately, particularly enjoying the battle royale mode. Thane then shared that he has been playing some "Apex Legends" recently and appreciated the characters and abilities in that game. Li Hua mentioned that he loves the strategy involved in "Warzone," like planning his approach and working with teammates, and highlighted the adrenaline rush during the final circle. Thane expressed his appreciation for the "clutch moments" in the game, mentioning a specific instance where they managed to secure a win at the last second. Li Hua then asked Thane about memorable victories in "Warzone," to which Thane recalled an unforgettable match where they managed to outsmart the last team despite being outnumbered. Li Hua and Thane both expressed enthusiasm about the upcoming updates in "Warzone," with Thane mentioning looking forward to fresh maps and modes that could bring excitement. Li Hua confirmed her intention to play again when the updates are released, suggesting they should team up together.
